purpose: Ingest authoritative cross-domain sources surfaced by raw states 10443, 34041, 43941, 94143 and 19344, emphasizing CI security, endpoint security, secure nonvolatile memory, production quality roles, flow-cytometry standards and chemical-regulatory assessment without promoting their identifiers as Glob evidence.

source_ingestion_policy.rule: Every substantive unique publication, dataset, advisory, standard, method, software resource, operational precedent, commercial signal or information item receives a Worldshepherd use when it materially improves any capability, or an explicit negative-control role.
source_ingestion_policy.duplicates: Vendor advisories, NVD records, mirrors and alternate landing pages describing the same vulnerability/publication are provenance aliases and are not independent evidence.
source_ingestion_policy.search_noise: CVE IDs, DOI components, occupational classification codes, standard numbers and regulatory notification numbers may be highly useful to Worldshepherd but have zero automatic Glob evidence unless the digits independently encode a verified physical quantity.

sources.title: CVE-2024-10443 — Synology BeePhotos/Photos Task Manager OS command injection
sources.note: Use remote unauthenticated command-injection failure mode to harden media/photo/task-processing services and administrative surfaces. 10443 is the CVE identifier.

sources.title: CVE-2026-34041 — nektos/act GitHub Actions environment/PATH injection
sources.authority: NIST National Vulnerability Database / GitHub advisory
sources.note: Use as a direct CI trust-boundary control: act before 0.2.86 processed deprecated set-env/add-path commands from workflow stdout; patch boundary is 0.2.86. 34041 is the CVE identifier.

sources.title: CVE-2026-43941 — Electerm terminal hyperlink argument/protocol injection
sources.authority: NIST National Vulnerability Database / GitHub advisory
sources.note: Use as an operator-interface hardening case: remote terminal content must not be allowed to hand arbitrary URL schemes directly to an OS external-handler path. 43941 is the CVE identifier.

sources.title: Embedding security into ferroelectric FET array via in situ memory operation
sources.note: Use device/array experiments and architecture evaluation as a secure-NVM/compute-in-memory design reference. The 43941 occurrence is DOI metadata.

sources.title: NOC 2021 — 94143 Testers and graders, food and beverage processing
sources.note: Use sampling, routine product-specification tests, grading and sanitation-conformance duties as a production quality-control/workforce-role reference. 94143 is an occupational classification code.

sources.title: ISO 19344:2015 — Quantification of lactic acid bacteria by flow cytometry
sources.note: Current/reconfirmed in 2026. Use standardized cell-counting method plus specificity/overestimation caveats as a quality-control and measurement-governance precedent. 19344 is the standard number.

sources.title: New Substances Notification No. 19344 — risk assessment summary
sources.authority: Environment and Climate Change Canada / Health Canada
sources.note: Use as a chemical pre-market/risk-assessment governance reference under CEPA, including regulatory decision framing. 19344 is the notification number.

information_updates.finding: CVE-2026-34041 makes workflow stdout itself a security boundary when local Actions runners interpret workflow commands. Worldshepherd CI should reject deprecated command channels and ensure any local runner/emulator is at or beyond its fixed version.
information_updates.claims_boundary: Security utility is independent of the 34041 numeric collision.

information_updates.finding: The FeFET work demonstrates security co-design at device, circuit and architecture levels by performing lightweight encryption/decryption through intrinsic memory operations, with experimental array validation and workload-level comparison.
information_updates.claims_boundary: The DOI digits do not constitute physical Glob evidence.

information_updates.finding: NOC 94143 provides a formal external ontology for shop-floor testing/grading duties, useful when Worldshepherd maps human quality-control roles into ISA-95/OPC UA and lifecycle-support workflows.

Canada NSN 19344 and ISO 19344 together show two independent non-physics uses of the same five digits—chemical regulatory assessment and measurement standardization—providing a strong namespace-collision control while also expanding governance capability.
information_updates.claims_boundary: Cross-namespace equality is not a Glob relation.
